name: jury-progress
description: Shows the live ai-jury runs inside Claude Code: one line per run above the prompt, each seat's state, and a /jury-progress pane, read from the metadata-only events ai-jury (1.24.0+) writes while this mod's .watched marker is on, or to $JURY_EVENTS_DIR. Read-only; it never runs jury.

capture.title: Watch the jury runs
capture.description: Leave a .watched marker in ai-jury's cache (…/ai-jury/events) so every jury on this machine writes its progress there. Off: the marker reads off, and only a JURY_EVENTS_DIR you set yourself is read.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to read the events while a run is live. With no live run it reads five times less often.

band_rows.title: Runs above the prompt
band_rows.description: How many runs the band shows before '+N more'.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a toast when a run ends (its verdict and findings) or stops without finishing.
